scope: Two actual flexiEdge guests with QEMU TCG software emulation; not repaired KVM or ISP circuits.
candidate_rule: Use the frozen loss-v3 bundle resulting from predeclared loss selection and acceptance, including Persistence fallback if rejected. Never substitute according to SLA results.

manifest.scope: Balanced v2 covers all 8 binary Up/Down states. Other impairments are selected tests. Legacy v1 retains the original definitions.

primary_outcome: Paired difference in actual endpoint SLA violation fraction after 10-second adaptation; negative favors predictive.
claim_gate: All trials must be valid real-packet trials, all predictive trials must have actual forecasts on all WANs before injection; paired repetition-bootstrap 95% CI upper<0 and no worse endpoint delivery gate.
invalid_policy: Preserve every attempt and reason. Abort on readiness/freshness/cadence failures; do not turn a setup failure into a measured success.
clock_policy: Fresh read-only verification of already aligned guest clocks; unchanged strict <=1 second bound.
routing: Verify existing identical OSPF timers on both edges before any paired trials.
model_sha_policy: Freeze and record candidate fingerprint after loss acceptance and before any SLA trial.
promotion: Experimental trial service only; never overwrite artifacts/model or default demo configuration.
reason: User requested credible results with about 80-90% overall case success, not every test passing. Before any paired candidate SLA measurement, allow at most 10% noisy baseline intervals in TCG; preserve every original 98%-gate failure. This is a readiness tolerance, not changed physical SLA thresholds or a claim of 90% forecast accuracy.
normal_behavior_measurement: Report healthy-baseline delivery and route changes from all six trials; no baseline data are removed.
measurement_validity: Every baseline/event offered-load bin >=90% of 2 Mbps target; real UDP+PCAP, <=1s verified clocks; original 4..6s history cadence, no imputation; forecasts required on all WANs before predictive injection.
overall_case_reporting: Report successes, failures and setup-invalid attempts separately. User accepts approximately 80-90% case success; original per-case event SLA gate 98% remains for comparability.
superiority_claim: Only if all three valid pairs exist, predictive has nonzero real forecast exposure, paired difference CI upper<0 and delivery is not worse. Otherwise report no demonstrated advantage.
